definitions.gloss: lending rate; interest rate on loans
definitions.explanation: The rate of interest a bank charges when it lends money. Contrasted with the deposit rate a bank pays to savers; the gap between them is the bank's margin.

examples.japanese: {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{比|くら}べた→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Lending rates differ by bank, so it's better to compare.

examples.english: If the Bank of Japan raises its policy rate, bank lending rates will be affected too.

notes:
A standard term in banking and financial news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧／⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: lending rates rise / fall
- {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the lending rate
- ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: low interest rates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: deposit rate — what the bank pays you, the mirror image of this term
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}→政策金利：26656_seisakukinri⟧: policy rate — the central bank's benchmark, which drives lending rates
- ⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧: interest — the money itself, not the rate
